children: reported third-quarter adjusted EPS of $1.31, above the analysts' consensus of $1.27, but revenue of $34.31 billion missed the $34.77 billion estimate as equipment revenue fell 9%. Verizon shares were down 3.78% intraday as of 9:30 a.m. ET.

Postpaid phone net additions reached 406,000, the strongest third quarter in five years, and postpaid phone churn improved to 0.94% from 0.98%. Verizon said the equipment decline reflected lower upgrade volumes, as customers hold their devices longer, and a strategic cut in device subsidies. Free cash flow rose 12.1% to $7.8 billion. One year into our transformation, Verizon is fundamentally stronger, CEO Dan Schulman said.

Verizon raised its full-year guidance for the third straight quarter, lifting postpaid phone net additions to 1.1 million to 1.2 million and adjusted EPS to $5.04 to $5.06. It expects mobility and broadband service revenue to grow about 4% in the fourth quarter. Separately, it signed an AI infrastructure agreement with Amazon Web Services valued at more than $2 billion.

title: Verizon Stock Falls Despite Third Straight Guidance Raise
